title: Da Buddha Essential Oil Kit (eNail or eBanger)
description:
Elevate your dabbing experience with the Da Buddha Essential Oil Kit, your premier choice for a high-performance desktop e-nail dab kit. This comprehensive set is specially designed to transform your Da Buddha Vaporizer into a dabbing powerhouse, whether you prefer cool temp dabs or intense, hot hits. The kit features a high-quality DBV Quartz Dab Dish paired with a DBV Heater Stand Adapter and a 10mm Dab Dish Hose Adapter for seamless integration.

Also included are a 10mm Sick Clip, an Elev8 Premier Carb Cap, tubing, a pick with a flat tip, tidy tips, and a dab mat to keep your setup neat. Opt for the Da Buddha Desktop e-Nail Dab Kit in sleek black and discover the ultimate in dabbing efficiency and style. Perfect for both newcomers and connoisseurs, this kit ensures every session is nothing short of extraordinary.
